title: A Rainy Morning
text:
Ola gets up early on Monday. It is cold and raining outside, so she puts on her red coat and her warm boots. She also takes a big umbrella.

At school, Ola takes off her wet coat and hangs it near the door. Her boots are wet too. In the afternoon the sun comes out, and Ola is happy because the sky is blue again.

questions.text: What does Ola put on when it is cold and raining?
options: A red coat and warm boots

questions.text: Where does Ola hang her wet coat?
What is the weather like in the morning?
Why does Ola probably feel better in the afternoon?
options: Because it stopped raining and the sun came out

vocabulary.definition: an object you hold above your head to stay dry when it rains
strong shoes that cover your feet and ankles
when water falls from the sky in drops
having a fairly high temperature that feels pleasant

paragraph_translations: Ola wstaje rano w poniedziałek. Na dworze jest zimno i pada deszcz, więc zakłada czerwony płaszcz i ciepłe buty. Bierze też duży parasol.
W szkole Ola zdejmuje mokry płaszcz i wiesza go przy drzwiach. Jej buty też są mokre. Po południu wychodzi słońce i Ola jest szczęśliwa, bo niebo znowu jest niebieskie.
